design_gotchas.title: Reversed U-Pinout SOT-23-5 (Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 4 = OUT) — Incompatible With TLV3201 & TLV7011
design_gotchas.detail: LMV331IDBVR places 1IN+ on Pin 1 and OUT on Pin 4 (matching LMV321IDBVR and TLV9001UIDBVR), whereas standard SOT-23-5 comparators TLV3201AIDBVR and TLV7011DBVR put OUT on Pin 1 and IN+ on Pin 3. Swapping footprints shorts output to input and breaks the circuit.

design_gotchas.title: Zero Headroom Above 5.5 V (Abs Max = 5.5 V) and Open-Collector Output Cannot Pull Above VCC+ + 0.3 V
design_gotchas.detail: Unlike 36 V LM393 comparators, LMV331 absolute maximum VCC is only 5.5 V (identical to recommended max) and recommended VOUT max is VCC+ + 0.3 V. Do not use LMV331 to level-shift to a rail higher than VCC+, and guard 5 V rails against inductive overshoot.

design_gotchas.title: Mandatory External Pull-Up Resistor & No Internal Hysteresis
design_gotchas.detail: Open-collector Pin 4 only sinks current (10 mA min / 84 mA typ at VO <= 1.5 V, VSAT = 150 mV typ at 4 mA) and requires an external pull-up resistor. LMV331 has no built-in hysteresis, so add positive feedback for slow or noisy analog inputs.

design_gotchas.title: Input Common-Mode Range Includes Ground Only (0 to VCC - 0.8 V, NOT Rail-to-Rail)
design_gotchas.detail: VICR at VCC+ = 5 V is -0.1 V to 4.2 V (and -0.1 V to 2.0 V at 2.7 V). Signals approaching VCC+ exceed common-mode headroom; unlike TLV7011 or TLV3201, LMV331 cannot sense high-side near the positive rail.

typical_use_cases: Low-cost 3.3 V and 5 V ground-sensing threshold detectors and wired-AND fault buses
Compact SOT-23-5 single-channel replacement for legacy LM393 circuits on 2.7 V-5.5 V rails
Appliance, power tool, and server PSU supervisory comparators requiring 26 µA quiescent current
Single-comparator window detectors where open-collector outputs share a common pull-up node
engineering_summary: The Texas Instruments LMV331IDBVR is a low-voltage (2.7 V-5.5 V), single-channel open-collector comparator in a 5-pin SOT-23 (DBV) package rated -40°C to 125°C. Drawing just 26 µA typical with 200-300 ns propagation delay and 150 mV saturation voltage at 4 mA, it brings LM393-style open-collector flexibility to compact 3.3 V/5 V boards. Engineers must verify its reversed U-pinout (Pin 1 = IN+, Pin 4 = OUT — incompatible with TLV7011/TLV3201), 5.5 V absolute-maximum supply ceiling, non-RRI upper input headroom (VCC - 0.8 V), and mandatory pull-up resistor.

audit_notes: Vision-verified LMV331 DBV/DCK 5-pin SOT-23 Top View on 300 DPI PNG page 3 (Table 4-1): Pin 1 = 1IN+, Pin 2 = GND, Pin 3 = 1IN-, Pin 4 = OUT, Pin 5 = VCC+ (U-pinout).
Verified Absolute Maximum VCC = 5.5 V, Recommended 2.7-5.5 V, TA = -40 to 125°C, and DBV RθJA = 224 °C/W on 300 DPI PNG page 4 (Sections 5.1, 5.3, 5.4).

Verified 5 V Electrical & Switching specs on 300 DPI PNG page 6 (Sections 5.7, 5.8): VIO = 7 mV max (25°C), IIB = 0.005 nA typ (5 pA), ICC = 26 µA typ, tPLH = 300 ns / tPHL = 200 ns at 100 mV overdrive.
Ordering table PNG page 16 confirms LMV331IDBVR Active, Production, SOT-23 (DBV) 5-pin, 3000 LARGE T&R, -40 to 125°C, marking R1IF/R1IK.
